title: Alt Text Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the alt text policy for all image contexts. Enforces: every image context declares alt_text_required, decorative images have empty_alt_permitted and aria_hidden, max character length defined, prohibited phrases listed, CMS field referenced, and auto-generation rule declared.

error_codes.ALT001: alt-text-policy.json missing or invalid — required fields: contexts[] with name, alt_text_required
error_codes.ALT002: Image context missing alt_text_required declaration — every context must explicitly declare whether alt text is required
error_codes.ALT003: Decorative context missing empty_alt_permitted or aria_hidden declaration — decorative images must declare both flags
error_codes.ALT004: Max character length not defined for image context — declare max_length (typically ≤ 125 characters) per context
error_codes.ALT005: Prohibited phrases list is absent — declare phrases that must not appear in alt text (file names, 'image of', etc.)
error_codes.ALT006: CMS field reference not defined for image context — each context must map to its CMS alt text field
error_codes.ALT007: Auto-generation rule not declared — declare whether automated alt text generation is allowed or not-allowed
